messages.content: I am working on a fictional character who is a dark unseelie fae king and am having a hard time fleshing him out. He is ancient, powerful, with a dark past but loyal to his people and cause, not afraid to get his hands dirty or do something underhanded to reach his ends. He is based on bits and pieces of the following characters; Klaus Mikaelson, The Darkling and Irial from the Wicked Lovely series.  Help me come up with a clear physical description, personality, backstory and any other details relevant. Answer with a list of items, instead of bullet points use -. No two consecutive words can share the same first letter.
